about_the_game:
Experience the ultimate fight for survival on a deserted island

Wake up in the ruins of an ancient civilisation where nature has taken over again. Your mission? Survive, adapt and build a new settlement in the heart of an unknown island full of pitfalls, secrets and unseen threats. Every day is a test, every night a challenge.

Join the others or be left alone

You're not the only one on the island. You can connect with other survivors, share resources, build defences and face danger together. But be careful - not everyone has honorable intentions. Trust is rare and betrayal is closer than you think.

Build, explore, survive

Gather resources, make tools and reshape the world around you. Explore every nook and cranny of the island, uncover hidden places and take every opportunity to strengthen your settlement. What you build can save your life.

Embark on a journey of renewal

Rebuild a settlement that once thrived. Bring life back to a place where only ruins remain. Re-landscape, build outposts, protect your community and write a new story for a place that has been forgotten.

Are you ready to face the island?

Don't wait for hunger, darkness or danger to catch up with you. Enter DuskIsle, where every step could be your last - or your first to a new beginning.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: dual core 2.00GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 670 2GB / AMD R9 280 better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 980 / AMD R9 Fury
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Explore a deserted island, collect resources, build a settlement from the ruins and survive the pitfalls of the wilderness. Every step holds danger, every night brings a new challenge. Nature will break you or make you stronger.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
